title: Detecting Prefix Bias in LLM-based Reward Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prepending explicit gender identity prefixes (e.g., "I am a woman.", "I am a man.") to candidate responses and measuring the reward model's auto-influence (winrate deviation) and cross-influence (accuracy deviation).

Prepending explicit racial identity prefixes (e.g., "I am black.", "I am white.", "I am hispanic.") to candidate responses and evaluating shifts in the reward model's preferences and accuracy using auto-influence and cross-influence metrics.
